subject.title: [Feishu] 飞书群多机器人身份混乱问题

question: Should Feishu group conversation identity become account/app-scoped for multi-account bots, and what migration or compatibility path should existing Feishu group sessions use?
rationale: The fix changes durable session identity and can affect transcript continuity, route binding, message delivery, and account-security boundaries, so automation should not choose the permanent key contract alone.

options.title: Account-scope Feishu group sessions
options.body: Include stable Feishu account/app identity in group session keys and pair it with doctor migration, docs, tests, and live multi-bot proof.

options.title: Keep shared group sessions
options.body: Document that multiple Feishu bots in one group intentionally share group context and close or narrow the bug to mention detection only.

options.title: Add opt-in isolation first
options.body: Preserve existing group keys by default while adding an explicit account-isolated mode with migration guidance for adopters.

recommendation.title: Account-scope Feishu group sessions
recommendation.body: Include stable Feishu account/app identity in group session keys and pair it with doctor migration, docs, tests, and live multi-bot proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue is inside the bundled Feishu plugin boundary, and package metadata points to this handle for Feishu ownership.
